jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming science into clear and compelling regulatory documents that drive successful drug development? We are seeking a talented and experienced Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing to join our CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism) Clinical Regulatory Writing team in Gothenburg, Sweden. With more than 2,400 employees from over 50 countries, our vibrant Gothenburg site is a truly inspiring place to work - where the history and future of scientific breakthroughs come together. We believe that the diversity of our people is crucial to bringing new discoveries to life.



Accountabilities:

The CVRM Clinical Regulatory Writing group provides expert strategic leadership and communications expertise to clinical drug programs, ensuring delivery of high-quality, label-focused documents aligned with project strategy, regulatory requirements, and communications best practices. Role holders not only author critical clinical-regulatory documents but also act as critical reviewers to achieve the highest quality standards. Team members also represent the Clinical Regulatory Writing skill set on both drug and non-drug projects, advocating for best practices and continuous improvement.



Key Responsibilities

As an Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing, you will:

    

Provide strategic leadership and communication expertise to clinical drug programs across the CVRM portfolio.

    

Author and critically review clinical-regulatory documents, ensuring the highest regulatory, technical, and quality standards.

    

Represent Clinical Regulatory Writing on project teams, advocating for communication best practices.

    

Provide strategic communications leadership within clinical delivery or submission teams, establishing standards and promoting quality and efficiency.

    

Act as NDA/MAA submission lead, driving the development of the clinical Submission Communication Strategy (cSCS) and successful submission delivery.

    

Lead both internal and external authoring teams and cultivate strong partnerships with vendor medical writers to ensure timely, high-quality document delivery.

    

Translate complex clinical data into clear, concise, and accurate messages tailored to specific audiences.

    

Support the development and upskilling of colleagues within the Clinical Regulatory Writing function.

    

Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence in communications.



Essential Skills/Experience:

    

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.

    

Significant medical writing experience within the pharmaceutical industry or a Contract Research Organization (CRO).

    

Proven ability to advise and lead communications projects and teams.

    

Strong understanding of drug development and the communications process from early development through to launch and lifecycle management.

    

In-depth knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements relevant to clinical regulatory writing.



Desirable Skills/Experience:

    

Advanced degree in scientific discipline (e.g., Ph.D.).



If you are driven to deliver impactful regulatory communications, excel in multidisciplinary teams, and want to shape the future of clinical development, we encourage you to apply.



Apply with your CV and cover letter by 30 August!

Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta telineasennuksista tai muista rakennusalan asennustehtävistä, mutta huomioimme haussa myös motivoituneet hakijat, joilla on halu oppia uusi ammatti.

Odotamme sinulta:

- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa

- vastuullista ja turvallista työotetta

- valmiutta työskennellä korkealla

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- sujuvaa yhteistyökykyä.

- omaa autoa työkohteisiin siirtymisen helpottamiseksi

- monipuolisen ja fyysisen työn vaihtelevissa kohteissa

- ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen

- laadukkaat työvaatteet ja työvarusteet

Työ alkaa vuokratyösuhteella, ja hyvin sujuneen yhteistyön jatkuessa työsuhteen on mahdollista jatkua asiakasyrityksessä.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Myyjiä, S-market Pohjolankatu Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

S-MARKET POHJOLANKATU IISALMI etsii nyt MYYJIÄ vakituisiin työsuhteisiin - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 4-37,5 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

S-market Pohjolankatu on Iisalmen keskustaan avautuva uusi kauppapaikka, jossa pääset mukaan rakentamaan myymälän toimintaa alusta asti. Uudessa S-marketissa luodaan yhdessä tekemisen tavat, jotka helpottavat niin asiakkaiden asiointia kuin tiimin yhteistä työskentelyä. Laajojen aukioloaikojen myymälässä päivät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia, ja jokaisen työntekijän panos näkyy heti. Onnistuminen syntyy siitä, että myymälä on kunnossa, asiakkaat kohdataan hyvin ja työkaverit pidetään mukana.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa - välillä olet myös asiakasetsivä, joka auttaa löytämään sen oikean jogurtin. Työhösi kuuluu lisäksi hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa, eli pidät huolen siitä, että hyllyt ovat täynnä ja hävikki pysyy mahdollisimman pienenä. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan saloihin: kassasta kuormaan, kampanjoiden esillepanoon ja varaston hallintaan asti. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa, tartut hommiin reippaasti ja tykkäät tehdä töitä yhdessä muiden kanssa - ja jos arvostat poikkeuksellisen hyviä henkilökunta-aleja, kannustavaa työporukkaa ja sitä pientä ylpeyden tunnetta, kun asiakas lähtee kaupasta hymy huulilla. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja odotamme hakijoilta valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa toimipaikan laajojen aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös öisin ja juhlapyhinä.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme kaupan alan työkokemusta ja koulutusta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkka, 11,16 €/t - 14,93 €/t kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa: jos itse haluat.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.8.2026.

Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö Mari Levoskin, mari.levoskin@sok.fi tai kenttäpäällikkö Joonas Marjanen, joonas.marjanen@sok.fi, puh. 050 348 6353


Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: HR & Compliance Analyst
jobs.employer: A&M HOGS HEAD GOLF CLUB LIMITED
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Responsibilities Collect, model, and analyse HR data across headcount, turnover, absence, recruitment, training completion, and labour costs, and translate findings into clear reporting for the HR Manager and General Manager. Build and maintain HR dashboards and management reports, identifying trends, anomalies, and cost or risk drivers. Produce workforce planning analysis to support annual headcount, budget, and HR strategy decisions in partnership with the HR Manager. Benchmark HR metrics against hospitality and golf sector best practice and advise on performance gaps. Analyse and monitor compliance of employee records and HR processes against company policy, employment law, and data protection obligations. Conduct regular audits of HR systems and files, quantify areas of non-compliance, and recommend corrective action with defined timelines. Maintain audit-ready documentation and produce compliance reporting for management review. Assess the confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of employee data held across all HR systems. Review existing HR processes and policies, model their effectiveness, and recommend data-driven improvements to strengthen consistency and reduce risk. Support the development, implementation, and evaluation of company policies and procedures, measuring adoption and impact. Analyse Schoox training-system data to track mandatory-training completion, identify gaps by department, and report on remediation. Provide analysis-led guidance to Heads of Department on HR, compliance, and workforce matters. Present findings, risks, and recommendations to management in a clear, evidence-based format. Investigate and analyse employee-relations and complaint data alongside the HR Manager to surface root causes and systemic issues, escalating complex legal matters to external counsel. Support recruitment analysis, including time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and selection reporting, in conjunction with the HR Manager. Perform other analytical duties as assigned by management. About You Third-level qualification in Human Resource Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Minimum of 1 years of basic experience in an HR or compliance role. Demonstrable ability to collect, model, and interpret data and turn it into actionable recommendations. Sound knowledge of HR best practice, and data protection requirements. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with HR information systems, reporting, or dashboarding tools an advantage. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and a methodical, evidence-based approach. Working Hours: 39 Hours Per week Annual Salary: 36,605.00 Company: A&M Hogs Head Golf Club Limited t/a Hogs Head Golf Club Job Location: Hogs Head Golf Club, Waterville, Co. Kerry, Ireland, V23 X381 Start date: 28/09/2026

jobs.title: Toyota ja Nissan -työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
Tule rakentamaan autoalan tulevaisuutta kanssamme!

Suomen Autohuolto Oy on voimakkaasti kasvava, henkilö- ja hyötyajoneuvojen merkkihuoltoon keskittynyt edelläkävijä ja yli 170 ammattilaisen työpaikka. Olemme valtuutettu merkkihuolto ja varaosajälleenmyyjä 14 huippumerkille: BMW, Citroën, Cupra, Ford, Hyundai, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, Opel, Peugeot, Seat, Škoda, Toyota, Volkswagen ja Volvo. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kuudessa toimipisteessä Oulussa, Tampereella ja Järvenpäässä, minkä lisäksi vauriokorjauksiin erikoistunut tytäryhtiömme Korimekaanikot Pirkanmaa Oy operoi kolmessa pisteessä Pirkanmaalla ja toimii Teslan valtuutettuna vauriokorjaamona. Huollamme ja korjaamme toimipisteissämme yli 50 000 ajoneuvoa vuosittain. Yhteensä 31 miljoonan euron liikevaihtomme ja tuloksentekokykymme takaa sinulle vakaan ja kehittyvän työympäristön – liity tiimiimme!

Haemme nyt työnjohtajaa/huoltoneuvojaa Ouluun Toyota ja Nissan -merkkihuollon toimipisteeseemme.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa puhelimitse tai digitaalisia kanavia pitkin tulevien asiakaskontaktien käsittely, yleinen asiakaspalvelu, töiden vastaanottaminen/luovuttaminen, yhteydenpito Toyotan ja Nissanin maahantuojiin sekä mekaanikkojemme varauskalenterin hallinta. Meillä pääset työskentelemään osana Toyotan ja Nissanin maailmanlaajuista huoltoverkostoa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- Vakituisen työn autoalan kasvuyrityksessä

\- Asiantuntevan tiimimme sekä Toyota ja Nissan maahantuojien ja valmistajatehtaiden tuen jatkuvalle kehittymisellesi autoalan ammattilaiseksi

\- Valmistajatehtaan/maahantuojan merkkikohtaisen koulutuspolun

\- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Hyvää ja reipasta asennetta työtä kohtaan

\- Vahvaa asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä sekä halua oppia jatkuvasti uutta

\- Aiempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelutyöstä sekä autoalalta

Tavoitteenamme on tehdä työmme tehokkaasti ja olla asiakaspalvelussa alamme parhaimmistoa, joten odotamme että jaat nämä tavoitteet kanssamme. Kaikille uusille työntekijöillemme pidetään talon oma perehdytysjakso, mutta koulutus ja oppiminen ei lopu siihen. Tarjoamme tehtävään maahantuojan ja tehtaan koulutusputket. Ammattitaitoa ylläpidetään myös säännöllisin täydennys- ja päivityskoulutuksin.

Katsomme eduksesi aiemman kokemuksen Autofutur -järjestelmästä ja/tai merkkihuoltoympäristöstä, mutta tärkeimpinä ominaisuuksina pidämme oikeaa asennetta työntekoon sekä reipasta asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä.

jobs.title: Architecte du bâtiment (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Architecte Responsable d'Agence capable d'allier expertise technique, pilotage de projets et esprit entrepreneurial.
Votre mission
Rattaché à la Direction Générale du groupe, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et opérationnelle de l'agence de Barcelone.
Vous intervenez sur les projets de l'esquisse jusqu'à la réalisation, tout en participant à la structuration de l'activité locale, à la coordination des équipes et au développement futur du pôle Barcelone.
Vos principales responsabilités
Expertise technique et suivi des projets
- Assurer la mise au point des projets de l'esquisse au DCE : plans, coupes, façades, carnets de détails ;
- Établir et superviser les pièces écrites et graphiques relatives aux dossiers administratifs : PC, PA, permis de démolir ;
- Produire et suivre les pièces graphiques relatives aux marchés de travaux ;
- Gérer, coordonner et synthétiser les éléments des différents intervenants : maîtrise d'ouvrage, services d'urbanisme, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle, partenaires techniques ;
- Analyser la faisabilité technique des projets et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Développement, coordination et management
- Participer à la structuration de l'agence de Barcelone et de ses méthodes de travail ;
- Contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration et au pilotage progressif des futures équipes ;
- Développer un réseau de partenaires et représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur ;
- Participer au développement de nouvelles activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives innovantes.
Profil recherché
- Formation Architecte ou équivalent ;
- Expérience confirmée en cabinet d'architecture, bureau d'études, ingénierie, construction ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation bâtiment : ERP, RT 2012, RE 2020, Code du Travail, ICPE, PMR, CDAC/CNAC ;
- Maîtrise des outils professionnels : Autocad, Revit, Photoshop, SketchUp, BIM ou équivalent ;
- Expérience en coordination de projets, pilotage d'activité ou management appréciée ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et capacité à structurer une activité locale ;
- Rigueur, réactivité, sens du relationnel et goût pour le travail en équipe ;
- Goût pour l'innovation constructive et les environnements internationaux.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compétence technique, nous recherchons une personne capable de s'investir durablement dans un projet ambitieux, avec l'envie de participer activement à la construction et au développement d'une organisation appelée à jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration :
- CDI ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des partenaires du groupe ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Cleaning Inspector/Service Manager
jobs.description:
Cleaning Inspector (Quality Control Inspector)

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Cleaning Inspector to join our professional cleaning company in Denmark.

As a Cleaning Inspector, you will be responsible for ensuring that residential and commercial cleaning services meet the

company's quality standards. You will conduct inspections after cleaning, identify areas that require improvement, provide

feedback to cleaning staff, and ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

* Inspect completed cleaning work at residential and commercial properties.

* Ensure all cleaning tasks meet company quality standards.

* Report any issues and follow up on corrective actions.

* Train and guide cleaning staff on proper cleaning procedures and quality expectations.

* Communicate professionally with clients when necessary.

* Complete inspection reports using a mobile phone or tablet.

* Monitor cleaners' performance and maintain high service standards.

Requirements:

* Previous experience in professional cleaning or quality inspection is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.

* Good communication skills in English (Danish is an advantage but not required).

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple locations.

* Valid driver's license is an advantage.

* Reliable, responsible, and punctual.

We Offer:

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

* 37 Hours per week

Training and career development opportunities. A supportive and professional work environment.

* Opportunity to grow within a fast-growing cleaning company.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in delivering excellent quality and ensuring every client receives outstanding service.

jobs.title: Exploration Manager
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Do you want to join us at Boliden and lead exploration strategy and discovery delivery across one of Europe’s most prospective mining regions?

We are looking for a Department Manager in Exploration to drive growth, prioritization, and value creation in the Central Fennoscandia region. The region is centred on the Skellefte District, one of Europe's premier volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) districts. It includes three operating mines, as well as several exploration ventures and projects.

Who you will work with

As Department Manager for Exploration in the Central Fennoscandia region, you are accountable for the full exploration value chain, from early-stage greenfield to near-mine initiatives across the Skellefte district.

Together with your first line managers, you lead the prioritization of exploration projects, balance long-term discovery potential with short-term business needs and allocate resources to maximize value creation and organic growth across the whole region.

What you will do

The department's goal is to extend the life of mine for all operating units within the region, provide opportunities for growing and expanding the operations, and search for new discoveries to sustain the region.

You will lead and develop the regional exploration portfolio, ensuring alignment with Boliden’s overall growth strategy and long-term resource development pipeline. You will also take part in discussions regarding project prioritization and ongoing exploration activities outside of your immediate area of responsibility.

The role includes:

    Strategic leadership - Contribute actively to overall exploration strategy, prioritization and investment decisions.
    Discovery alignment – Continuously assess and evaluate the growth potential of the region and align it with business goals and expectations.
    Resource & portfolio management - Own regional budgets, forecasts and portfolio performance, ensuring optimal allocation of capital across projects.
    Personnel – Lead three section managers with a total of around 30 employees.
    Safety, wellbeing & environmental performance – Ensure strong performance in safety, wellbeing and environmental responsibility across the department.
    Stakeholder & regulatory relations – Liaise with stakeholders and governmental authorities, while ensuring projects follow applicable laws and regulations for mining and exploration companies in each country.
    Contractor & consultant management – Negotiate with and manage cooperation with contractors and consultants.

You report to the Exploration Director and participate in Boliden’s Exploration Management Team, contributing to strategic decisions across the full exploration portfolio. The position is based at the Boliden Office or at one of Boliden Mines’ locations. Frequent travel is required, as well as regular presence at the Boliden Office.

What you bring

You have a university degree in geosciences and substantial experience in mineral exploration or mining, including a proven track record in leadership roles. You also have experience managing exploration portfolios, leading multidisciplinary teams, and working in complex stakeholder environments.

We place emphasis on your ability as a manager to motivate others and provide clear leadership in line with Boliden’s leadership principles. You are committed to developing the team, the region, and the company. You are results-oriented, with a focus on discovery and on creating both short- and long-term value. We expect you to share our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility.

You need to be fluent in English. Swedish and/or Finnish language skills are considered a merit. A Category B driving licence is required.

Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

You will have a direct impact on shaping the future resource base of Boliden and have a role in delivering sustainable growth for the company.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Jon Keisu Lundh, +46 70 242 71 81, Jon.Lundh@boliden.com.

For questions about the application process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73 350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70 541 83 93 and Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910 77 40 09.

Submit your application by: Sunday, 30 August 2026

We may select candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate, send in your application. We look forward to it!

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, assessments and background checks may be included in the recruitment process.

If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.title: Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen, 15 to 37 hours a week
jobs.description:
Job title:
Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen. No experience required.

The job

You stand in Copenhagen and stop strangers. You have thirty seconds to make them care about something that matters, and then you ask them to put their money where their heart is.

Most walk past. Some stop. A few say yes, and those are the ones that fund real work by real organisations.

It is the oldest job there is: convince a human being, face to face, with nothing but your voice.

What you actually get out of it

Forget the job. Here is the skill.

By month three you will be able to walk up to anyone, anywhere, and start a conversation that goes somewhere. You will be able to hear no fifteen times and go straight into the sixteenth conversation without flinching. You will know how to ask for something and get it.

Almost nobody has that. The people who do run companies, close deals, get hired over better candidates, and talk their way into rooms they were not invited to.

You cannot learn it from a book. You learn it by doing it four hundred times. We pay you while you do.

The money

Good Guaranteed base +

Commission on top, no ceiling. Holiday allowance and pension on top of that.

The hours

Anywhere from 15 to 37 a week.

Where it goes

We started in February 2026. We are already growing, which means the ladder above you is short and mostly empty. We promote from inside, and people have moved up to team leader in months, not years. Get good and you will be leading people before most of your friends finish their first probation period.

Straight talk

This job is not for everyone, and we would rather tell you now.

Apply

Hit apply. One minute. No CV, no cover letter, no motivation essay.

https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

We reply within two working days. Interviews every week. Start within two weeks.

Three positions. Questions, call August on 25 78 10 13.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de Village Vacances (H/F)
jobs.description:
Prenez la direction d'un village vacances 3* Atout France situé à Sevrier, à 8 km d'Annecy, offrant une vue panoramique sur le lac et un cadre exceptionnel pour des séjours en pension complète ou demi-pension. Vous serez responsable de la gestion globale du village, de la satisfaction client, du management des équipes et de la performance opérationnelle et financière de la structure.
Typologies de clients principales : Séminaires (accueil de groupes professionnels), Groupes loisirs (associations, clubs, comités d'entreprise), Familles (séjours multigénérationnels, animations adaptées).
Ouverture : Toute l'année (fermeture annuelle 4 semaines février / mars).

VOS MISSIONS :
Vous serez le garant de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la rentabilité et de l'expérience client au sein d'un village de 155 chambres (rénovées en 2020), doté d'un restaurant panoramique, d'un bar, d'une piscine extérieure, d'un parc paysager de 3,5 ha, et d'équipements dédiés aux loisirs.
1. RELATION CLIENT ET SATISFACTION
- Garantir une expérience client irréprochable pour les trois typologies (séminaires, groupes loisirs, familles).
- Piloter la qualité des prestations (hébergement, restauration, animations, services techniques).
- Développer l'accueil des séminaires : logistique, équipements adaptés, services sur mesure.
- Superviser les animations (programmes variés pour familles et adultes, semaines thématiques).
- Assurer la gestion des réclamations et proposer des solutions adaptées.
2. MANAGEMENT ET RESSOURCES HUMAINES
- Recruter, former et encadrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire
- Organiser les plannings en tenant compte des pics d'activité.
- Animer les réunions d'équipe et favoriser la coopération interservices.
- Gérer les conflits et maintenir un climat social positif.
- Évaluer les performances et mettre en place des plans de développement.
3. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET FINANCIÈRE
- Piloter le budget du village et rendre compte à la direction générale.
- Optimiser les coûts (achats groupés, gestion des stocks, maintenance préventive).
- Superviser la maintenance des infrastructures et veiller au respect des normes ERP, HACCP et sécurité.
- Assurer la passation entre saisons (clôtures comptables, inventaires).
- Développer des partenariats locaux.

VOTRE PROFIL
Formation et Expérience
- Bac+2 à Bac+5 en management hôtelier, tourisme, gestion d'entreprise ou équivalent.
- Expérience : Minimum 3 ans en tant que Directeur(trice), hôtel-club 3*+
- Expérience impérative dans la gestion de séminaires et groupes loisirs.
Compétences Techniques
- Gestion financière : Maîtrise des budgets, tableaux de bord, analyse de rentabilité.
- Outils informatiques : Suite Office, logiciels de gestion hôtelière, outils de réservation en ligne.
- Réglementaire : Connaissance du droit du travail, des conventions collectives, et des obligations légales.
- Capacité à assurer un reporting structuré, précis et constant.
Qualités Humaines
- Leadership et exemplarité : Capacité à fédérer et motiver des équipes en contexte saisonnier.
- Polyvalence et adaptabilité : Gestion simultanée de publics variés et d'imprévus.
- Sens du service client : Empathie, écoute, réactivité et justesse.
- Rigueur et organisation : Gestion des priorités et respect des délais.
- Résistance au stress : Capacité à gérer les pics d'activité.

Acteur du tourisme associatif depuis 1949, la marque Neaclub est née en 2018 de la fusion de deux associations du tourisme social et familial : Les Carrefours de l'Amitié et Chemins. Aujourd'hui, Neaclub gère 5 villages-club labellisés 3 étoiles Atout-France, ainsi qu'un chalet-refuge en Haute-Savoie, Savoie et en Drôme Provençale :
- Les Balcons du lac d'Annecy situé à Sevrier (74) ;
- Les Cîmes du Léman situé à Habère-Poche (74) ;
- La Pulka situé à Valloire (73) ;
- La Lauza situé à Valmeinier (73) ;
- Les Lavandes situé à Rémuzat (26) ;
- Le Chalet-refuge

jobs.title: Key Account Manager / Milwaukee
jobs.description:
Key Account Manager with strategic focus
Techtronic Industries Nordic, Finland

Do you want to join us on the MILWAUKEE® growth journey?

Do you have a winning attitude, and are you passionate about building strong relations?

Techtronic Industries Nordic, Finland

TTI Nordic is a well-consolidated company, which markets and sells a wide range of power tools, hand tools, outdoor products, accessories, and PPE equipment under the leading market brands MILWAUKEE® and Ryobi®. We sell through a large network of distributors in the Nordic and Baltic countries. End customers are typically professional users and quality-conscious DIY people.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to further strengthen Milwaukees position in the exciting market, building strong partnerships with new and existing customers across Finland, as well as our Category Sales Managers internally. We are looking for a colleague with a can-do attitude, as we strive to always come up with the best possible solutions to support both our customers and colleagues across the region. You come with experience as a Key Account Manager or Product Manager and have a clear expertise of the Finnish market situation, to easily identify the best solution for greater success with different kinds of customers, across the region.

The key factors for your success are experience in Key Account Management, determination, and the ability to build long-term and trusting customer relationships. We appreciate an energetic way of working and believe that strong communication skills are key to succeeding in the role. You will work with a high level of stakeholders, where strong negotiation skills are required and thus the ability to see the larger picture, even when the good solutions take a little longer to reach – we are in it for the long run. We believe constructive feedback is important and in TTI Nordic we value trust and teamwork, and we do our best each day to raise the bar, working as a strong business partner to our customers and colleagues.

Join us on our green and innovative journey!

Our products have been developed with the green transition in mind, where we convert traditionally heavy, noisy, air- and petrol-powered products into quiet battery-powered products that also consider the work environment and ergonomics in the product. You will have a great influence on our further development in the Baltic region, and you will work in areas such as zero emissions, world goals, safety, CSR, and the environment based on our long-term green strategy.

You work from your home office, and your time is equally spent talking to your customers and the Finnish sales organization. For this role, travel days will be expected, as well as visits to Copenhagen during onboarding, for customer visits booked in the Copenhagen office, as well as our yearly Nordic Conference in week 32, where we gather all our employees from the Nordics and the Baltics.

Take charge of the entire sales process and develop the market with new customers!

You work at the strategic level where you negotiate, demonstrate and sell our range of specific power tools and accessories to both new and existing B2B customers – from the sustainability specialist to the workers on the construction site. In addition, you will have the primary responsibility for planning and following up several exciting sales activities at our dealers, in support with our Account Managers.

This means that you:

- direct and implement MILWAUKEE®'s campaign activities.
- maintain and develop existing customer relationships in collaboration with KAMs.
- follow up on leads for new business opportunities daily and update our CRM system.
- collaborate closely with marketing and product teams regarding customer needs and market trends.

Outgoing and relationship-building salesperson

- You have experience in sales and Key Account Management, with a proven track record.
- You have strong communication skills and can master these across cultures.
- You are native in Finnish and have a strong knowledge in working in English language too.
- You can see yourself in a role where you create long-term customer relationships.
- You have a high drive and energy plus a keen eye for new business opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Site Coordinator – Industrial Projects
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Site Coordinator for an exciting assignment with a leading international industrial company.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing plant modification activities within a designated work package. You will ensure that all work is carried out safely, on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with the required quality standards.

You will report functionally to the Site Coordination Lead and work closely with the Work Package Owner on a day-to-day basis. As the primary on-site contact, you will support activities related to foundations, concrete works, and installations.

Key Responsibilities

    

Coordinate and oversee daily plant modification activities within the assigned work package, ensuring safe execution, timely delivery, and compliance with project scope and quality requirements.

    

Act as the primary point of contact between the project team, contractors, and subcontractors regarding on-site plant modification activities.

    

Monitor project progress, identify deviations, recommend improvements, and escalate issues or changes when necessary.

    

Track and report project status, progress, risks, and deviations to the Project Manager and Work Package Owner.

    

Provide technical support and guidance to resolve site-related issues associated with plant modification activities.

    

Ensure that all work complies with applicable technical, safety, and quality standards.

    

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks that may impact project scope, schedule, or cost.

    

Escalate issues that may affect overall project delivery to the appropriate project stakeholders.

    

Support the evaluation of change requests and project variations by assessing their impact on cost, schedule, and quality.

    

Collaborate with other Site Coordinators and cross-functional project teams to ensure efficient coordination across interfaces.

    

Assist in preparing and reviewing daily, weekly, and monthly project reports, ensuring all documentation is accurate and up to date.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the assignment may be filled before the application deadline.

Requirements

    

Minimum of 7 years of experience in site coordination for large-scale infrastructure projects.

    

Strong knowledge of FG Condensate Treatment processes, Heat Pumps, plant modification methods, and construction practices, including site management and applicable health and safety regulations.

    

Fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.

    

Proven experience coordinating on-site activities, overseeing contractor performance, and ensuring plant modification work is completed according to the work package and schedule.

    

Ability to coordinate site activities while ensuring alignment with the overall project timeline and budget.

    

A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline is preferred. However, extensive hands-on experience in site coordination and execution of major infrastructure projects is considered equally or more valuable.

    

Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high standards of health, safety, and quality across all site operations.

Preferred Qualifications

    

Experience managing risks associated with plant modification activities, including safety-related risks and schedule delays.

    

Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure site environment while maintaining focus on project objectives.

Personal Skills

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to resolve on-site challenges effectively.

Additional Qualifications

    

Proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks and resolving issues before they impact project delivery.

    

Strong ability to maintain safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout all site activities.

    

Comfortable working under pressure while ensuring successful project execution

jobs.title: Project Manager Service
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Do you want to improve cancer care with innovative software? As Project Manager at RaySearch's Service Department, you will work with full product delivery and project implementation while collaborating with customers and colleagues globally. Join us in a quest to fight cancer!

About the role

As our Project Manager, you will belong to an expanding service organization and be part of our Global Service team. You will work with product deliveries across the RaySearch product suite, supporting clinics in Europe in implementing and deploying our oncology software solutions. You will lead several projects in parallel and work closely with Application Specialists, IT Specialists and other Project Managers. You will also collaborate with colleagues in Development, Finance and Sales Operations throughout your projects. When you start your position, you will get an introduction by your manager and work closely with a mentor who will help you familiarize yourself with our organization and ways of working.

You will be part of a growing Service department in a growing company that drives innovation in the MedTech industry. This is a full-time position at RaySearch’s head office located in Stockholm.

Your main tasks:

    Be the link between RaySearch and our customers during projects + lead the implementation and upgrade of projects.
    Be responsible for planning and coordination as well as follow-up on actions and deadlines.
    Act as intermediary between team members from Service, Development and Sales to coordinate the projects, and to participate in the allocation of resources in collaboration with Team Managers.
    Communicate with customers and internal stakeholders.
    Participate in activities to continuously improve internal processes and routines.

Your profile

To be successful in this position we think that you are a team player with excellent interpersonal skills who understand the importance of communication. Also, we believe that you are interested in innovative technology and curious to learn more about our products and the use and utility for our customers. You are not afraid of challenges, and you easily adapt to new situations and solve problems as they arise. Multitasking comes natural for you as you are both a strong organizer and administrator.

Requirements:

    2+ years’ experience from project delivery management within IT/MedTech.
    University degree (or equivalent) in relevant field.
    Experience in leadership and from working with structured project methodology.
    Great verbal and written communication skills in English.
    A service minded, positive attitude and ability to work independently.
    Experience from maintaining compliance and project documentation.

It is meriting if you have:

    Experience from the medtech and/or healthcare industry.
    Project management certifications.

Our Culture

Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems, no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.

Our Offer

At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Application

Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Ria Financial Services is looking for a driven and service-oriented employee for the role of Sales Cashier/Store Employee. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.

This is a part-time position located in Stockholm, starting around mid-December. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You are responsible for providing an outstanding customer experience while contributing to achieving our sales goals.

    Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.

    Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
    Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.

We are looking for you who

    Has experience in cashier work and handling of cash (meritorious).

PERKS & BENEFITS

    An exciting and dynamic work environment in an international company.
    Opportunity to develop in sales and financial services.
    An inclusive and multicultural team where we value diversity.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team at Ria Financial Services!

Please note that for security reasons, we request an extract from the criminal record before employment can be carried out.

Ria Money Transfer is an employer that promotes equal opportunities. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
jobs.description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to provide information to the same extent as the candidate for security clearance.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 September. We will conduct interviews on a continuous basis. If you have any questions, please contact Camilla Schneider Bergman, Head of Architecture & Technology M: +45 29 11 16 39. (Not available until 1 September)

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja – tule Verden tuuraajatiimiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kuntokeskus Verdeen innostavia ja luotettavia ryhmäliikunnanohjaajia tuuraustehtäviin.

**Haluaisitko ohjata ryhmäliikuntaa joustavasti oman aikataulusi mukaan?** Verden tuuraajatiimissä voit ottaa vastaan vapaita tunteja silloin, kun ne sopivat sinulle. Tuuraustyö sopii hyvin esimerkiksi muun työn tai opiskelun rinnalle sekä liikunta-alan yrittäjälle.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Verdessä järjestetään ryhmäliikuntaa seitsemänä päivänä viikossa. Tuntivalikoimaamme kuuluu muun muassa lihaskuntoharjoittelua, pumppia, kuntopiiriä, zumbaa ja sisäpyöräilyä.

Kevät- ja syyskaudella järjestämme noin 20 ryhmäliikuntatuntia viikossa maanantaista sunnuntaihin. Vakituisten ohjaajiemme rinnalle etsimme uusia tuuraajia esimerkiksi sairastumisten ja muiden poissaolojen varalle.

Voit ottaa tuurauksia vastaan oman aikataulusi ja tilanteesi mukaan. Hyvin sujuneiden tuurausten kautta voi myöhemmin avautua mahdollisuus myös omiin vakituisiin tunteihin.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Toivomme sinulta liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta. Ennen kaikkea etsimme ohjaajia, jotka nauttivat ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja osaavat luoda tunnille kannustavan ja hyvän ilmapiirin.

Asiakkaamme ovat pääasiassa noin 30–50-vuotiaita aikuisia, joista monet liikkuvat säännöllisesti. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi tulla tunnille omana itsenään ja saada onnistumisen kokemuksia omasta lähtötasostaan riippumatta.

**Saatat sopia joukkoomme, jos**

- sinulla on koulutusta tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta

- olet energinen, kannustava ja luotettava

- viihdyt erilaisten ihmisten parissa

- haluat tehdä ohjaustyötä joustavasti muun elämäsi rinnalla.


Työ sopii hyvin myös esimerkiksi toiminimiyrittäjälle.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

· En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag.

· Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.

· Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

· Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og bonusordning.

· Computer, telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

· Mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.

· Frihed under ansvar og fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som en del af JWC Staffing Agency, og har du lyst til at være med på vores vækstrejse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til jwc@jwc-staffing.dk med emnet "Salg".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
