Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.

Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.

jobs.title: Director of Expeditions
jobs.description:
Director of Expeditions - School in Switzerland

A prestigious and internationally renowned boarding school in Switzerland is seeking an outstanding Director of Expeditions to lead one of the most distinctive outdoor education programmes in the world. Reporting to a senior member of the leadership team, the successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership for a large-scale expedition programme encompassing mountain, ski and adventure-based learning experiences. This is a rare opportunity for an experienced outdoor education professional with strong leadership credentials, technical expertise in alpine environments and a passion for developing young people through challenge, resilience and discovery.

JOB PURPOSE
The Director of Expeditions serves as the strategic lead for Aiglon’s renowned expedition department. The post holder is responsible for the development and delivery of the programme’s vision and ethos, ensuring it is progressive, relevant, and distilled into a coherent curriculum across the whole school. They provide leadership to a team of qualified expeditioners and ensure that all activities are managed with the highest standards of safety and risk management.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES FOR THE POSITION

1. Strategic Leadership & Vision

Visionary Design: Develop and oversee the philosophy and approach of our expedition programme, ensuring it reflects our aim to continue to be world leading in outdoor pursuit provision.
Curriculum Development: Develop and implement the expedition programme ensuring it is progressive for all students, regardless of age or length of stay at Aiglon.
Challenge: Ensure challenge is appropriate to ability and context, acknowledging that expeditions serve pastoral and community-building purposes alongside physical stretch.
Reinforce the purpose of expeditions: independence, resilience, responsibility and growth.
Holistic Assessment: Take a lead role in the school’s development of holistic assessment within the expedition context.
External Engagement: Seek to build relationships with the wider community to share expertise and gain insights from external best practices, with particular emphasis on risk management.

2. Operational Oversight & Management
Team Leadership: Provide instruction and guidance to the Head of Senior and Junior Expeditions in their operational oversight.
Leadership: Provide inspiration, leadership and guidance to all teaching staff involved in expeditions with the expectation to deliver the highest standards and professionalism.
Staff Development: Manage professional reviews, appraisals, and training (internal and external) for the expedition staff.
Meetings: Chair expedition department meetings and work closely with both Junior and Senior heads to ensure departmental alignment.
Stakeholder Liaison: Liaise with the School Council, Assistant Heads, Houseparents, and academic departments.
Recruitment: Oversee and support the recruitment of all expedition staff, including guides.
Development: Monitor and continually improve the process of student reflection.
Administration: Ensure all paperwork and communication is complete, efficient and effective.
Budgets: Preparation and management of all Expedition budgets
Administration: Use Aiglon’s data management system to record and organise all expeditions
Mountain School: Line-manage the Junior Mountain School Programme, with specific liaison with the Bear Grylls Survival Academy
Summer Camp: Act as the senior advisor for all summer expedition activities, ensuring a robust handover of safety protocols and operational standards to the Summer School team while maintaining ultimate accountability for safeguarding and risk management frameworks.
3. Safety, Risk & Compliance
Safety Evaluation: Oversee and evaluate the safety protocols of the entire expedition programme.
Risk Management: Encourage and verify a high level of risk management documentation and ensure operating standards align with best practice.
Open Culture: Ensure a safe and open environment for staff to share experiences and opinions to improve safety.
Compliance: Ensure that all equipment and its usage comply with current PPE and safety standards.
Work closely with the HR team and Director of Compliance to ensure compliance with all necessary processes relating to recruitment of guides.
Ensure that qualifications of all staff and Guides are appropriate.
Safeguarding: Ensure all staff and Guides receive safeguarding training at regular intervals. There is an expectation to uphold the highest standards of safeguarding.

4. Logistics & Equipment Management
Planning & Bookings: Oversee and guide administrative support and the Heads of Expeditions to ensure bookings are made with a nine to twelve-month lead-in.
Stores Management: Manage the expedition stores, including the upkeep, care, and long-term planning for equipment.
Inventory Systems: Manage robust systems for recording inventories and maintenance schedules.
5. Communication & Ethos
Internal Communication: Ensure students, staff and parents receive effective and efficient information regarding upcoming expeditions through assemblies, staff meetings, bulletins and external communication.
External Communication: Work with communications, admissions, and advancement teams to ensure clear and inspiring messaging to the wider community, that is delivered to a high professional standard..
Institutional Values: Contribute enthusiastically to the life and work of the school, upholding the Aiglon ethos, including the delivery of meditations.
GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
The Director of Expeditions is expected to be visible and motivational presence and contribute to the overall life of the Aiglon community
Undertake additional responsibilities as may arise at the reasonable request of the Director of Character Education and the Director of School.

The qualifications, experiences and attributes of the post holder must match the detailed specification below:
A. Education, Qualifications and Languages
Essential

Swiss-recognised International Mountain Leader/Accompagnateur
Winter mountaineering or ski qualification
Rock Climbing Instructor
First Aid certification
Driving licence
Professional working proficiency in French and a fluency in English

Desirable

Teaching qualification
Holder of an IFGMA qualification
Higher level qualification in other adventure activities:
Paddlesports
Mountain Biking

B. Experience and Knowledge
Essential

Experience in health and safety auditing, incident management protocols, and Swiss legal requirements for high-risk activities.
Experience in managing department budgets, equipment procurement, and overseeing a team of full-time and freelance staff.
Experience in designing progressive outdoor education programs that align with educational frameworks
Experience leading and teaching young people and groups in the European mountains in a variety of adventurous activities
Highly competent skier
Professional-level competence in winter navigation and avalanche safety
Experience in the creation and delivery of presentations and information to a wide range of audiences

C. Personal Qualities, Attitudes and Behaviours
Essential

Ability to build professional relationships with students within the clear boundaries of Aiglon’s safeguarding policies.
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively across all stakeholders.
The ability to inspire confidence in staff, students and parents whilst articulating the value of risk to the School Council and Board of Directors.
Proven ability to remain calm and lead a team through high-pressure emergency situations in remote environments.
Aiglon expects the Director to have a commitment to continuous professional development, staying at the forefront of international outdoor education trends and safety standards; they should also be expected to mentor junior staff in their professional development.

jobs.title: AI Product Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Product Counsel on the Product and IP Legal team, you’ll focus on advising our AI product development team as they build and ship AI functionality—covering everything from product counseling for launches to accelerating AI partnership deals. This role exists because Notion is building the AI workspace that helps every person and team get more done, with intelligence embedded across the tools they use to think, create, and collaborate. We’re bringing frontier intelligence to the “Fortune 5 million,” across an unusually broad surface area (models, workflows, features, and platform). This role is central to that effort. This role reports to our Head of Product and IP Legal and will work closely day-to-day with our Lead AI Product Counsel.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Accelerate partnerships for AI product development: collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to streamline and de-risk the partnership path, including model reviews, procurement and evaluation agreements.

 - Value add AI product development: provide pragmatic, product-oriented counsel that helps teams ship AI features and iterations quickly and responsibly. Monitor and translate emerging AI regulations into practical product guidance, launch requirements, and risk-based recommendations for cross-functional teams.

 - Support customer-facing AI questions by partnering with Sales, Privacy, Security, and Product to provide clear, accurate responses on Notion AI capabilities, safeguards, and commitments.

 - Pitch in to provide product legal support across the business as bandwidth allows.

By day 90, you’ll…

 - Build strong context on Notion AI’s product surface, roadmap, and risk posture, with trusted relationships across AI Product, Engineering, Privacy, Security, Procurement, and GTM.

 - Ship a practical AI contracting and model-review playbook that helps teams move quickly on vendor deals, model launches, and evaluation agreements without re-litigating the same questions.

 - Start using AI in your own practice to draft redlines, summarize risk positions, maintain reusable clauses, and spot issues faster across AI vendor and product work.

By the end of year 1, you’ll…

 - Establish a scalable AI legal operating model for vendor procurement, model approvals, product counseling, regulatory tracking, and customer-facing AI questions.

 - Become a go-to advisor for AI launches at Notion, translating fast-moving product, regulatory, and customer trust issues into clear recommendations and durable guardrails.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of product counseling experience with a technology company and/or law firm (in‑house experience strongly preferred), including advising cross-functional teams on AI/ML-powered product development.

 - Experience reviewing and negotiating vendor agreements (including identifying risk and moving quickly from “issues” to workable paths).

 - AI and data licensing experience, with strong partnership across Privacy and Security to translate model, data, and customer requirements into practical product and vendor terms.

 - Sound judgment in ambiguity: make crisp risk calls, name trade-offs clearly, and keep teams moving.

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role.

 - A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and admission to the California or ability to be registered as in-house counsel in California.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $260,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer



Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

jobs.title: Køkken souschef søges til Muban Thai Roskilde
jobs.description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL THAIRESTAURANT

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret køkken souschef, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift i vores thairestaurant.

Du bliver en central person i køkkenet og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og resten af teamet. Vi leder efter dig, der har passion for det thailandske køkken, tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

Om restauranten

Vi er en thairestaurant med fokus på autentiske smage, gode råvarer og retter tilberedt med respekt for det traditionelle thailandske køkken.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte køkkenchefen i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

  • Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

  • Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

  • Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

  • Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

  • Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

  • Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

  • Hjælpe med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende køkkendrift – også når der er ekstra travlt

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Gerne har erfaring med thailandsk eller anden asiatisk gastronomi

  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med at lede og koordinere et køkkenteam

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt som en del af et hold

  • Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan bevare roen og prioritere opgaver i travle perioder

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og ensartethed i køkkenet

  • Gerne har kendskab til woktilberedning, curries og traditionelle thailandske smage

  • Har forståelse for køkkenhygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til thai er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En vigtig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og god energi

  • Mulighed for at arbejde professionelt med thailandsk gastronomi

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Varierende arbejdsdage og ansvar i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Fleksibel planlægning af vagter

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke er bange for at tage fat, og som gerne vil være med til at udvikle både køkkenet og teamet.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR THAI RESTAURANT

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef to become an important part of the daily operation of our Thai restaurant.

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Thai cuisine, takes responsibility and is able to stay organised and focused in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

About the restaurant

We are a Thai restaurant focused on authentic flavours, quality ingredients and dishes prepared with respect for traditional Thai cuisine.

Our kitchen prepares a variety of dishes, including wok dishes, curries, noodles, rice dishes and classic Thai specialities. Quality, flavour and consistency are very important to us, and we aim to provide our guests with a great experience every time they visit or order from us.

We offer both dine-in service and takeaway, which means that teamwork, planning and efficiency are essential parts of our daily kitchen operation.

Your main responsibilities

As Kitchen Sous Chef, your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

  • Taking responsibility for kitchen operations when the Head Chef is not present

  • Coordinating tasks and maintaining an efficient workflow during busy service periods

  • Ensuring consistent standards of taste, quality and presentation

  • Taking an active part in food preparation, production and mise en place

  • Planning prep work and distributing tasks among kitchen staff

  • Training, supporting and assisting new kitchen employees

  • Contributing to strong teamwork and a positive working environment

  • Managing deliveries, stock levels and correct storage of ingredients

  • Helping reduce food waste and maintaining efficient use of ingredients

  • Ensuring compliance with food hygiene and food safety procedures

  • Contributing ideas for new dishes and menu development

  • Helping maintain an organised and efficient kitchen during both normal and busy service periods

About you

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen

  • Preferably has experience with Thai or other Asian cuisine

  • Has experience with, or an interest in, supervising and coordinating kitchen staff

  • Can work independently while also being a strong team player

  • Is organised, reliable and responsible

  • Can remain calm and prioritise tasks during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on quality and consistency

  • Preferably has knowledge of wok cooking, curries and traditional Thai flavour profiles

  • Understands food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and responsibilities

  • Can communicate in English. Knowledge of Thai is an advantage but is not required.

We offer

  • A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

  • An important role with responsibility and influence on daily kitchen operations

  • A professional and informal working environment focused on teamwork and quality

  • The opportunity to work with authentic Thai cuisine

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Varied responsibilities and working days

  • Flexible shift planning

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

We are looking for a Sous Chef who enjoys taking responsibility, working as part of a team and contributing to the continued development of both the kitchen and the restaurant.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and Italian




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €144,000 - €156,000  per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:

Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with employers to expand organisational recruitment networks, strengthen workforce engagement, and identify sustainable employment opportunities. Identify workforce requirements through continuous employer engagement, labour market intelligence, and sector analysis to support organisational employment initiatives. Coordinate employer engagement activities, business outreach programmes, and partnership development to strengthen employer participation and programme outcomes. Build and maintain collaborative relationships with employers, public sector agencies, educational institutions, healthcare partners, and community organisations to enhance employment networks and workforce development initiatives. Collaborate with multidisciplinary programme teams to support integrated service delivery, operational planning, and achievement of organisational objectives in accordance with established procedures. Design and implement employer engagement strategies, including customised workforce solutions, recruitment initiatives, and business development activities aligned with programme objectives. Facilitate employer consultations, partnership meetings, networking events, and stakeholder engagement activities to promote organisational programmes and strengthen employer participation. Monitor labour market trends, workforce demands, sector developments, and regional employment opportunities to support strategic planning, employer engagement, and programme development. Manage programme operations by ensuring compliance with organisational policies, contractual obligations, operational standards, quality assurance requirements, and governance frameworks. Maintain accurate programme records, analyse employment and operational performance data, prepare management reports, and support evidence-based decision-making. Coordinate employment programme activities through effective stakeholder communication, operational planning, and continuous service improvement initiatives to achieve organisational performance targets. Support employer onboarding, workforce retention initiatives, and post-placement employer engagement to strengthen long-term business relationships and employment sustainability. Ensure compliance with GDPR, organisational governance requirements, confidentiality obligations, quality assurance standards, and all applicable operational procedures. Participate in organisational meetings, professional development programmes, national networking initiatives, and cross-sector collaborations to support continuous improvement and service excellence. Contribute to organisational planning, programme innovation, performance improvement, and strategic workforce development initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and employer engagement outcomes.

jobs.title: Spanien Abonnemangssäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till kallkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

Haluatko olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä kansainvälisille vieraillemme Lapin taian keskellä? Etsimme tiimiimme energistä, oma-aloitteista ja palveluhenkistä hotelliassistenttia monipuoliseen ja inspiroivaan rooliin boutique-hotellimme sydämessä.

**Aurora Queen Resort** on Saariselällä sijaitseva boutique-hotelli, joka tunnetaan korkeatasoisesta iglumajoituksesta sekä lämminhenkisestä ja vieraanvaraisesta palvelusta. Hotellimme yhteydessä toimii tyylikäs 49-paikkainen à la carte -ravintola, joka muodostaa boutique-hotellimme sydämen sekä tunnelmallisen ja rennon kohtaamispaikan vieraillemme. Samassa tilassa toimii myös hotellimme vastaanotto, mikä tekee ravintolasta luonnollisen kokoontumispaikan ja tärkeän osan hotellimme ainutlaatuista tunnelmaa.

Talvikausi kestää marraskuun puolivälistä maaliskuun loppuun.

**Työnkuva**

Työssäsi pääset osaksi hotellimme päivittäistä toimintaa hyvin monipuolisessa roolissa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Asiakkaiden sisään- ja uloskirjautumiset

- Sähköpostien ja varausten hoitaminen

- Päivittäisten työtehtävien organisointi

- Aikataulujen ja käytännön toimintojen koordinointi

- Avustaminen tarjoilussa a la carte ravintolassa ja muissa asiakaspalvelutehtävissä

- Tiimin tukeminen siellä, missä apua kulloinkin tarvitaan


Kyseessä on laaja, vaihteleva ja erittäin inspiroiva työnkuva, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta**

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta hotellissa työskentelystä

- Erinomaista palveluasennetta ja positiivista energiaa

- Rentoa mutta ammattimaista otetta asiakaspalveluun

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti myös kiireessä

- Hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja joustavuutta

- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- Intoa kohdata kansainvälisiä asiakkaita ja luoda heille mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia


Ajokortti ja oma auto ovat suotavia ( ei pakollinen ), sillä hotellimme sijaitsee noin 15 kilometrin päässä Saariselän keskustasta.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Erittäin Kilpailukykyisen palkan

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä inspiroivassa boutique-hotelliympäristössä Lapin luonnon keskellä

- Kansainvälisen asiakaskunnan ja monipuolisen työnkuvan

- Rennon, innokkaan ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi hotellin eri osa-alueilla

- Asunnon tai huoneen talvikauden ajaksi kauttamme kävelyetäisyyden päässä hotellilta

jobs.title: Tour Operator
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and operate FIT and group tours across the Nordic and Baltic countries.

  • Design customized itineraries based on clients' interests and market needs.

  • Coordinate all travel arrangements, including accommodation, transportation, guides, restaurants, and activities.

  • Negotiate rates, contracts, and service conditions with hotels, DMCs, transport companies, and other suppliers.

  • Prepare quotations, manage tour costs, and maintain product profitability.

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with travel agencies and business partners across Southeast Asia.

  • Resolve operational issues quickly and efficiently to ensure a seamless travel experience.

  • Work closely with internal teams and overseas partners to deliver exceptional service.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience as an Inbound Tour Operator for Southeast Asian travel market.

  • Experience handling FIT and group travel operations.

  • Strong itinerary planning and travel operation skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and excellent problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Solid understanding of the Southeast Asian travel market.

  • Knowledge of Southeast Asian cultures, travel trends, and customer preferences.

  • Existing network within the Southeast Asian travel industry.

  • Proficiency in Southeast Asian languages (Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, etc.).

  • Experience operating tours in the Nordic and Baltic regions.

  • Experience negotiating contracts and rates with hotels, transport companies, DMCs, and other suppliers.

  • Strong cost control and quotation preparation skills.

  • Experience handling travel emergencies and operational issues.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).

Why Join Us?

  • Work with one of the world's most exciting travel destinations.

  • Be part of an international and multicultural team.

  • Opportunity to develop and expand the Southeast Asian market.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

  • Competitive salary and benefits based on experience and qualifications.

If you are passionate about creating unforgettable travel experiences and have the expertise to grow our Southeast Asian business, we look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As a SC, you’ll own the full customer journey: from first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized. You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.



This role will be based in Paris, France. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and French




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

jobs.title: OPAS
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä Aurora Queen Resortin tiimin uusi jäsen?

**Etsimme tiimiimme OPASTA tulevalle talvikaudelle marraskuusta 2026 maaliskuun loppupuolelle 2027.**

Etsimme kokenutta ja palveluhenkistä opasta liittymään boutique-hotellimme tiimiin Lapin upeisiin maisemiin. Työskentelet pienten, kansainvälisten asiakasryhmien parissa ja tarjoat vieraillemme yksilöllisiä elämyksiä aidossa Lapin tunnelmassa.

Etsimämme henkilö on asiakaspalvelun ammattilainen ja hänellä on kokemusta oppaana työskentelystä Lapin talvisesongissa useamman vuoden ajalta.

**Mikä on Aurora Queen Resort?**

Aurora Queen Resort on perheomisteinen Boutique Hotelli, joka sijaitsee Saariselän alueella 15km keskustasta etelään.

Aurora Queen Resort avautui 1.Joulukuuta 2021, joten starttaamme nyt 6.talvikautemme.

Safaritalomme palvelee myös resortin alueella, ja sieltä omat oppaamme operoivat talviaktiviteetteja pienryhmille: Lumikenkäily, Moottorikelkkailu, Revontuliretket.

**Mitä Oppaan työhön kuuluu?**

- Laadukas ja ystävällinen asiakaspalvelu resortissa

- Pienten asiakasryhmien aktiviteettien suunnittelu ja toteutus, kuten lumikenkäretket, moottorikelkkailu ja revontuliretket

- Asiakaskuljetukset, kuten retkikohde- ja lentokenttäkuljetukset

- Kansainvälisen asiakaskunnan neuvonta ja avustaminen

- Yhteistyö paikallisten ohjelmapalveluiden kanssa

- Piha-alueiden ja kulkureittien lumityöt sekä liukkauden torjunta

- Safaritalon siisteydestä huolehtiminen sekä välineiden huolto

- Tarvittaessa avustaminen resortin päivittäisessä toiminnassa


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Useamman vuoden aiempaa kokemusta opastoiminnasta matkailualalla

- Reipasta ja joustavaa asennetta

- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Hyvää suomen-ja englannin kielen taitoa

- Valmiutta fyysiseen ulkotyöhön vaihtelevissa sääolosuhteissa

- B-ajokorttia ja ajokokemusta asiakaskuljetuksista

- Kokemusta moottorikelkkailusta asiakasryhmien kanssa

- Aitoa, positiivista, energistä ja iloista asennetta asiakaspalveluun

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana pientä ja tiivistä tiimiämme

- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen ( työajat ajoittuvat klo 8-00 välille maanantaista sunnuntaihin )


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä inspiroivassa ympäristössä kilpailukykyisellä palkalla, Lapin ainutlaatuisen luonnon ympäröimänä

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä pienten kansainvälisten asiakasryhmien kanssa

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn

- Työn jossa pääset tapaamaan päivittäin erittäin kansainvälistä asiakaskuntaa ja tekemään osaltasi heidän Suomen lomastaan ikimuistoisen


**Huomioitavia asioita:**

- Kauttamme löytyy asunto / huone talvikauden ajaksi


**Hae mukaan AQR Tiimiin talvikaudelle 2026-2027:**

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV sähköpostitse sekä kerro miksi juuri Sinä olisit hyvä lisä tiimiimme.

Laitathan mukaan myös listan mahdollisista suosittelijoista.

Toivottavasti kuulemme pian Sinusta!

- sähköposti nina@auroraqueenresort.fi

- Käsittelemme hakemukset heti niiden saavuttua ja aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

- Mikäli haluat lisätietoja, soitathan Ninalle puh. 040-5141185.

jobs.title: Service Mechanic
jobs.description:
**We are looking to welcome a Service Mechanic—or more familiarly, a Maintenance Technician—into our proud team for a permanent position. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our timber and material handling equipment, world-renowned for their quality, do what they are supposed to do.**

**What kind of proud Kesla team member are we looking for?** A requirement for succeeding in the job is a suitable educational background or equivalent knowledge gained in practice. Experience in the forestry machinery sector is a special plus. You have a good understanding of the basic principles of hydraulics, automation, and control systems used in forestry machinery, which is essential when troubleshooting heavy equipment. Since the work is often done at customer sites, you need good social skills. In addition to Finnish, English is required for the job—though if your attitude is right, "Rally English" will get you started. Your work is not tied to a single location; you travel wherever you are needed. In practice, your duties include maintenance repairs, equipment installations, and advising customers on maintenance work, spare part needs, and equipment failure situations.

Kesla is a smoke free workplace.

Etsimme keittiömestaria talvikaudelle 2026–2027 osaksi **Aurora Queen Resortin** tiimiä Saariselälle. Hotellimme tunnetaan korkealaatuisesta iglumajoituksesta ja premium tason palvelusta Lapin upean luonnon keskellä. Ravintolamme on tunnelmallinen 49-paikkainen à la carte -ravintola, jossa panostamme laatuun, makuihin ja vieraillemme mieleenpainuviin kokemuksiin.

Talvikausi kestää marraskuun puolivälistä maaliskuun loppuun.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta**

- Kokemusta keittiömestarin tai vastaavan esihenkilöroolin tehtävistä

- Positiivista asennetta, innokkuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- Kykyä johtaa tiimiä ja toimia kiireessä sekä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- Intohimoa laadukkaaseen ruokaan ja asiakaskokemuksen luomiseen


Ajokortti ja oma auto ovat suotavia, sillä hotellimme sijaitsee noin 15 kilometrin päässä Saariselän keskustasta.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Erittäin kilpailukykyisen palkan

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä laadukkaassa ja inspiroivassa ravintolassa Lapin luonnon keskellä

- Kansainvälisen asiakaskunnan ja mahdollisuuden luoda elämyksellisiä ruokakokemuksia

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työnkuvan

- Rennon, innokkaan ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen

jobs.title: Outdoor Activity Worker, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Outdoor Activity Workers for Lapland Safaris Saariselkä and Hetta for the Christmas season 2026.**

A workday of an Outdoor Activity Worker consists of various tasks including overseeing outdoor activities in a Christmas themed activity area surrounded by Lapland's beautiful nature. You will be working with international groups of guests, consisting of families with children. Your job is to make sure that all guests, children, and grown-ups are having a day full of joy and fun. The work is mostly independent, but at the same time you are a part of a big team which works in the same area.

Outdoor Activity Workers work during the busiest Christmas season, which means that working days are hectic and sometimes can be long. The length of the days varies according to the group and the program. The work includes preparation of the activity area and different kinds of maintenance work, as well as cleaning the area after the end of the day. The important task of providing clothing for our guests can also be your responsibility, as well as clothing maintenance.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish is very useful in Saariselkä. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement**

**In Saariselkä** you will introduce tobogganing, mini-skidoo, kick-sledding or tandem skiing to our guests. You can also be working at the reindeer info, pancake-hut or at the warmup cabin. You might also work as a road crosser, when you make sure that the guests are crossing the road safely, either by snowmobile or by walking. In addition, your work tasks may include clothing and equipment maintenance.

**In Hetta** your workplace can be the toboggan slide or bobsleigh hill, you might be teaching the guests to drive the snowmobile, or you might be serving ginger breads in the snow castle and telling stories about the castle itself. You might also be part of the very important team that organizes the visits to Santa Claus himself. In Hetta, providing clothing to the guests and clothing maintenance plays a big role in the Outdoor Activity workers daily routines and work tasks.

**What we expect from you:**

- Energetic and outgoing character

- Flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Good group management skills

- Christmas spirit and willingness to work with families, especially children


**What we offer you:**

- Great team and beautiful working surroundings

- Versatile and variable working days

- Easy way to experience arctic nature

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin in mid-November or at the end of November and will last approximately until the Christmas holidays in Hetta, and until the end of December 2026 in Saariselkä. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

For further information, please contact info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Yövastaanottovirkailija / Night Receptionist
jobs.description:
YÖVASTAANOTTOVIRKAILIJAN PAIKKA AVOINNA NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELÄLLÄ!

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ystävällistä yövastaanottovirkailijaa liittymään tiimiimme. Tämä rooli sopii asiakaspalveluhenkiselle henkilölle, joka haluaa työskennellä ainutlaatuisessa ympäristössä ja olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä vieraillemme Northern Lights Villagessa.

PÄÄTEHTÄVÄT:

* Vieraiden vastaanottaminen ja asiakaspalvelu

* Sisään- ja uloskirjautumisten hoitaminen

* Vieraiden kysymyksiin vastaaminen sekä paikallisten nähtävyyksien ja aktiviteettien esittely

* Varausten hallinta ja käsittely

* Vastaanottoalueen siisteydestä ja järjestyksestä huolehtiminen

* Raporttien laatiminen ja muut hallinnolliset tehtävät

* Yhteisten tilojen, kuten vastaanoton ja ravintolan, siisteyden ylläpito

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

* Vähintään vuoden kokemus hotellin vastaanottovirkailijan tehtävistä

* Sujuva englannin kielen taito (suullinen ja kirjallinen)

* Suomen alkoholipassi

* Erinomaiset viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

* Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä tiimissä

* Hyvät organisointi- ja multitasking-taidot

* Hotellivarausjärjestelmien tuntemus (Mews)

* Ammattimainen käytös ja ystävällinen asenne

* Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti (pakollinen tehtävässä)

EDUKSI KATSOMME:

* Ensiaputodistus

* Paikallisalueen tuntemus

* Muu kielitaito (englannin kielen lisäksi)

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Mahdollisuus henkilökohtaiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun

* Positiivinen ja kannustava työympäristö

* Henkilökuntaedut yrityksen palveluissa

* Kattava työterveyshuolto

TYÖN KESTO, PALKKA JA EDUT:

* Työ alkaa lokakuussa/marraskuussa Työ päättyy maaliskuussa

* Työtunnit 90 h/3vko (yötyö), KK palkka (2291 – 2469)

* Muut edut työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti

* Tarvittaessa järjestämme majoituksen jaetussa huoneessa hintaan 300 €/kk

Jos kiinnostuit, laitathan hakemusta tulemaan ja jutellaan lisää!


NIGHT RECEPTIONIST ROLE NOW OPEN AT NORTHERN LIGHTS VILLAGE SAARISELKÄ!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a proactive and friendly Night Receptionist to become part of our dynamic team. This role is ideal for individuals who excel at customer service and wish to work in a unique environment, contributing to the unforgettable experiences of our guests at the Northern Lights Village.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Welcoming guests and providing exceptional customer service

* Handling check-ins and check-outs efficiently

* Answering guests' queries and providing information about local attractions and activities

* Managing bookings and reservations

* Ensuring the reception area is tidy and well-organized

* Preparing reports and other administrative tasks

* Keeping common areas of reception and restaurant tidy

* Auditing accounting reports

REQUIREMENTS

* 1 or more years of experience in a hotel receptionist role

* Fluent written and spoken English

* Finnish alcohol passport

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

* Good organizational and multitasking abilities

* Knowledge of property management systems

* High level of professionalism and a friendly demeanour

* Valid category B driving licence (Mandatory)


DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

* First Aid Certificate

* Knowledge of local area

* Additional language skills

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary

* Opportunities for professional development and training

* A positive and supportive working environment

* Discounts across our properties and facilities

Pay, Duration and Benefits

* Start: October/NovemberEnd: March

* Working time: 90h/3week period (night work arrangement)

* Monthly salary based on experience and skills: €2,291 – €2,469/month + supplements in accordance with the collective agreement

* Other benefits according to the collective labor agreement

* If necessary, the resort provides accommodation in a shared room for €300/month

HOW TO APPLY

Before applying, please ensure you have the right to work in Finland.

Please note that due to the high volume of applications, we may not reply to applications that do not fulfill the stated requirements. Should your application meet the initial selection criteria, you will receive a reply in early August at the latest.

Ready to be a key player in providing unforgettable experiences at Northern Lights Village? Send us your application and a brief cover letter detailing why you're the perfect fit for our team. Were excited to hear from you!

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

jobs.title: Sähkö-ja automaatioasentaja
jobs.description:
**Asiakkaamme Alumatic Oy etsii sähköasentajaa** vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kangasalle.

Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisten sähkö- ja pneumatiikka-asennusten parissa sekä nähdä oman työsi valmistuvan käyttövalmiiksi ajoneuvoksi? Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan uusia ADR-säiliöajoneuvojen päällisrakenteita osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

Työ sisältää sähkökaapelointeja ja kytkentöjä, pneumatiikka-asennuksia sekä järjestelmien käyttöönottoa, koeajoja ja testauksia. Työ on vaihtelevaa ja tarjoaa sopivasti teknisiä haasteita sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Sinulla on sähköalan koulutus tai vastaava käytännön osaaminen sekä kokemusta sähköasennuksista esimerkiksi ajoneuvojen, raskaan kaluston, työkoneiden tai teollisuuden parissa. **Arvostamme** oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta, teknistä ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua tehdä laadukasta jälkeä.

Pneumatiikan tuntemus sekä kokemus raskaan kaluston varustelusta tai päällisrakennetöistä katsotaan **eduksi,** mutta tärkeintä on motivaatio oppia uutta.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työn vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa työskentelet nykyaikaisten ajoneuvoratkaisujen parissa. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen, osaavan työyhteisön tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammattilaisena.

Työtä tehdään **maanantaista perjantaihin päivävuorossa**, joten vapaa-aika jää hyvin omiin menoihin.

Jos kiinnostuit tehtävästä, lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

jobs.title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
jobs.description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

LOIMAA

Prisma Loimaa etsii tiimiinsä MYYJIÄ päivittäistavaraosastolle!
Tehtävät ovat vakituisia ja osa-aikaisia10-20tuntia viikossa.Tehtävien aloitus sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Myymälän arki on vauhdikasta ja täynnä erilaisia kohtaamisia, ja meille tärkeintä on, että jokainen asiakas lähtee meiltä hyvällä fiiliksellä.Päivittäistavaraosastoon suurin osasto, ja valikoimaan kuuluvat muun muassa tuoreet hedelmät ja vihannekset, liha-, kala- ja maitotuotteet, valmisruoat, säilykkeet, panimotuotteet ja kosmetiikka. Osastolla huolehditaan, että tuotteet ovat aina saatavilla, tuoreita ja siististi esillä.Päivittäistavaraosastoon kuuluu myös palvelutori, jossa käsitellään tuoreita liha- ja kalatuotteita sekä valmisruokia.Ruokatorilla työskenteleviltä myyjiltä tulee löytyä taskusta hygieniapassi.

Työpäivät koostuvat monipuolisista tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, hyllytystyöstä, verkkokaupan keräilystä, esillepanojen rakentamisesta sekä myymälän siisteydestä huolehtimisesta.Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Tehtävä edellyttää myös valmiutta työskennellä kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti kello5.30-22välillä.Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?

Olet etsimämme tyyppi, jos sinulla on reipas ja positiivinen työskentelyote.Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja nautit työskentelystä myymäläympäristössä. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissaja työtehtävissä,sekäkohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä.

Myyjän palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57€/h.Vuorotyössä ilta-, yö- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän tiimiin, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

💚 Ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen hyvillähenkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos jaEmotionmyymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %.

💚 Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessäSuomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa.

💚 Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakinPrisma-myymälöissäsekä kaikissaTOK:ntoimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet.

Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan16.8.mennessä!Meollaansinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidänviestitvoivat eksyä myös sinne.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa.Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä.Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana.Meitätokkilaisiaon reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. jobs.title: Bartender
jobs.description:
_Imagine an evening where locals and travellers from around the world gather around the bar, sharing stories over great drinks. Outside, the Arctic winter paints the landscape with snow and northern lights, while inside the atmosphere is warm, lively and welcoming. Panimo is much more than a bar – it's a legendary meeting place where memorable evenings are created every day._

**We are looking for a Bartender to join our team for the winter season 2026–2027!**

If you enjoy working with people, stay calm under pressure and want to create unforgettable customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

**In this role you will**

- prepare and serve a wide variety of drinks

- provide friendly and professional service to both Finnish and international guests

- work in a busy but supportive team environment

- experience the magic of Lapland throughout the winter season


**We hope you have**

- previous bartending experience or other relevant restaurant industry experience

- a positive attitude and excellent customer service skills

- good English language skills, Finnish language skills are considered an advantage

- a valid alcohol serving licence (Anniskelupassi)


If you hold a Finnish security steward licence (Järjestyksenvalvojakortti), please mention it in your application, as it is considered a significant advantage.

**What we offer**

- a fixed-term employment from 23 November 2026 until 11 April 2027

- salary starting from €14.50/hour, plus applicable collective agreement supplements. The final salary is based on your experience and qualifications.

- staff accommodation for fixed-term employees (shared twin room)

- Wilderness Hotels employee benefits

- the opportunity to spend the winter in one of Lapland's most iconic venues, together with a welcoming and international team


At Panimo, every team member plays an important role in creating the unique atmosphere our guests remember long after their visit. If you're ready for an unforgettable winter in Finnish Lapland, we'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Opas talvisesonkiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme opasta Lapin talvisesonkiin!

Tässä työssä tehtävänäsi on järjestää moottorikelkka- ja lumikenkäilykierroksia muiden oppaiden kanssa. Työ pitää sisällään myös tavaravuokrausta ja muita ylläpitotehtäviä kierrosten valmisteluun liittyen. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa 40h/vko ja alkavat marraskuussa, jatkuen ainakin maaliskuun loppuun saakka. Työsopimus solmitaan Henkilöstöliigan kanssa määräaikaisena.

Odotamme sinulta hyvää fyysistä kuntoa työn luonteen vuoksi, sujuvaa englannin ja saksan kielitaitoa sekä kokemusta moottorikelkoista. Oma-aloitteisuus ja joustavuus työtuntien suhteen on tärkeää. Auto on pakollinen työpaikan sijainnin vuoksi. Kaikkea kokemusta tai koulutusta eräoppaan tehtävistä pidetään etuna.

Tarjoamme määräaikaisen työn Lapin kauniista maisemista. Työehdot määrittää ohjelmapalvelualan työehtosopimus, mutta palkka on kokemuksen mukaan neuvoteltavissa.
