Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we structure our product teams https://www.youtube.com/watch?index=59&list=PLXDU_eVOJTx402DljIPagaDKLibF-qfF0&v=I4vvBidQcck talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

SIA “BIURO” (reģ. Nr. 40103607661), licencēts darbiekārtošanas pakalpojumu sniedzējs, sava sadarbības partnera SIA “HansaMatrix Pārogre” (reģ. Nr. 40103934323) vārdā aicina komandai pievienoties iekārtu operatorus.


Vadošs elektronisko sistēmu un to komponenšu ražotājs Ziemeļeiropā HansaMatrix, kas darbojas dažādās augsto tehnoloģiju nozarēs aicina darbā!

Piedāvājam

  • darba laiku maiņās 07:00 - 19:00 un 19:00 - 07:00 (darba dienās, ar spēju strādāt abas maiņas);
  • brīvas nedēļas nogales un svētku dienas;
  • nepieciešamo apmācību un darba aprīkojumu;
  • apmaksātus pārtraukumus un pusdienas, transporta kompensāciju no reģioniem (vismaz 10 km rādiusā no darba vietas).

  • latviešu valodas zināšanas vismaz A2 līmenī un angļu valodas zināšanas tehniskās dokumentācijas lasīšanai un izpratnei.
  • vēlamu pieredzi darbā iekārtām;
  • spēju lasīt un izmantot tehnisko dokumentāciju;
  • atbildības sajūtu, precizitāti un spēju strādāt komandā;
  • gatavību apgūt jaunas tehnoloģijas un darba metodes.

A Note from the Founder

Why Sticky is Free to Use

Hey â I'm Hamza Saleem, the solo developer behind Sticky.today.

In May 2026, I made a decision most SaaS founders won't make: I fired our payment processor and made Sticky completely free for everyone.

Here's why.

Software Should Be Free

Sticky started as a paid product. Pro plans, trials, subscriptions â the usual SaaS playbook. And it worked. People paid. But something felt off.

The best tools I've ever used didn't ask for my credit card. They just worked. Obsidian, VS Code, Blender â tools that respected me enough to not put a gate between me and my work. I wanted Sticky to be that kind of tool.

So I tore out every line of billing code. No more trials. No more upgrade prompts. No more payment gateways. Just a fast, free canvas for your ideas.

The Internet Has Enough Gatekeepers

Look around â every productivity tool wants $10-20/month from you. Per seat. Per feature. It adds up. And for what? Most of them are glorified text editors with a subscription attached.

Sticky is different. It's a spatial thinking tool built by one person who actually uses it every day. There's no board of investors demanding recurring revenue. There's no pressure to add "enterprise features" nobody asked for. There's just me, building software I believe in, and you, using it however you want.

I don't think thinking should cost money. Your brain doesn't charge you rent. Neither should your canvas.

What You Get (For Free)

Unlimited Boards

Create as many canvases as you need. No caps, no limits.

Real-Time Collaboration

Share boards and work together with live cursors.

AI Idea Generator

Brainstorm with GPT-4o-mini. 10 free generations per day.

Self-Hosting

MIT licensed. Run it on your own infrastructure.

Dynamic Tables

Insert editable tables alongside your sticky notes.

Dark Mode

Easy on the eyes. Built in from day one.

What's Next?

Sticky will keep improving. I'm building it in public â follow along on Twitter/X or check out the source code on GitHub. No investors. No roadmap dictated by revenue targets. Just a guy building software he believes in, for people who actually want to use it.

If you read this far, thanks. If Sticky helps you think, that's the win.

Follow on X View on GitHub

â Hamza Saleem, May 2026

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab söker inhoppare till hemvården i Ekenäs

Vi söker dig som studerar eller redan har utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen.

Inom hemvården ger vi stöd att bo kvar hemma och leva ett självständigt liv. Vi hjälper till med dagliga sysslor, personlig omvårdnad, socialt stöd eller vård i hemmet. Arbetet är självständigt och du jobbar i två skift, arbetstiderna är mellan kl.7.00-21.00. Arbetet sker främst i de två olika Folkhälsan husen samt i närheten av dem i Ekenäs. Ett godkänt läkemedelslov och hygienpass är nödvändigt.

Arbetet kräver följande behörigheter:

- För närvårdare krävs en närvårdarexamen eller motsvarande tidigare examen, såsom hjälpskötare eller primärskötare, med registrering i Valvira. Vi förutsätter att du som närvårdare också har ett godkänt läkemedelslov.
- Vi tar gärna även emot studeranden inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen med minst 60 studiepoäng.

jobs.title: Säljare
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu svensktalande säljare till vårt kontor i Málaga.

Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill utvecklas inom försäljning, arbeta i en internationell miljö och samtidigt få uppleva livet i Spanien tillsammans med ett ambitiöst team.

Hos oss arbetar du med investeringsrelaterade tjänster och har daglig kontakt med både kunder som redan visat intresse och nya potentiella kunder. Rollen passar dig som är driven, social och motiveras av att utvecklas både professionellt och ekonomiskt.

Du behöver inte vara en färdig toppsäljare från dag ett — det viktigaste är att du har rätt inställning, disciplin och viljan att bli riktigt bra på det du gör.

Vi erbjuder en strukturerad arbetsmiljö med tydliga mål, coaching och goda möjligheter att påverka både din utveckling och din inkomst.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta och följa upp både varma och kalla kunder
    Presentera bolagets tjänster på ett tydligt och professionellt sätt
    Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer
    Arbeta mot individuella och gemensamma mål
    Utvecklas löpande genom coaching och feedback

Vi söker dig som

    Talar flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    Är kommunikativ och trygg i telefon
    Har stark arbetsmoral och vill utvecklas
    Motiveras av mål, prestation och personlig utveckling
    Trivs i en miljö med tempo och ansvar
    Har tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning (meriterande men inget krav)
    Har svenskt eller europeiskt pass

Vi erbjuder

    Fast lön från 1 800 € per månad
    Provision och bonus utan lönetak
    Kontinuerlig coaching och utbildning
    Modernt kontor i centrala Málaga
    Internationell arbetsmiljö med stark teamkänsla
    Möjlighet till hjälp med flytt och etablering
    Tydliga utvecklingsmöjligheter för rätt person

Arbetet sker på plats i Málaga måndag till fredag enligt svenska arbetstider — vilket ger struktur i vardagen och friheten att njuta av livet i Spanien på kvällar och helger.

För rätt person kan detta bli starten på en långsiktig karriär inom försäljning och finans.

    Skicka in din ansökan med uppdaterat CV på svenska. Urval sker löpande.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

jobs.title: Karrosseritekniker, pladesmed eller dygtig svejser søges nær Auning
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med karrosseriarbejde, pladearbejde eller svejsning – og sætter du en ære i at levere et solidt stykke håndværk?

Rekruttering Djursland søger på vegne af en virksomhed nær Auning en dygtig og stabil medarbejder til en alsidig hverdag med reparation, tilpasning og svejsearbejde.

Du kan være uddannet karrosseritekniker, pladesmed, smed eller have opnået tilsvarende kompetencer gennem praktisk erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har hænderne godt skruet på og kan arbejde omhyggeligt og selvstændigt.

DINE ARBEJDSOPGAVER

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

- Reparation og tilpasning af karrosseri- og pladedele

- Svejsning og øvrigt metal- og konstruktionsarbejde

- Opretning, udskiftning og montering af dele

- Klargøring og efterbehandling af udførte opgaver

- Fejlfinding og vurdering af den rigtige reparationsmetode

- Kvalitetskontrol af dit eget arbejde

- Andre praktiske opgaver på værkstedet

De konkrete arbejdsopgaver bliver tilpasset din erfaring og dine faglige kompetencer.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

- Har erfaring med karrosseri, pladearbejde, svejsning eller beslægtede opgaver

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

- Har sans for kvalitet, finish og præcision

- Er praktisk anlagt og god til at finde løsninger

- Er mødestabil og bidrager positivt til samarbejdet

- Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

- Gerne har kørekort B

En relevant uddannelse og svejsecertifikater er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og de rette håndværksmæssige evner kan være mindst lige så vigtige.

VIRKSOMHEDEN TILBYDER

- En alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige faglige opgaver

- Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

- Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort vej fra idé til handling

- Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

- Mulighed for faglig udvikling og mere ansvar

- Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

- En fast fuldtidsstilling for den rette medarbejder

ARBEJDSSTED

Virksomheden ligger i området ved Auning på Djursland.

ANSØGNING

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette medarbejder. Samtaler afholdes løbende, og opslaget kan derfor blive lukket, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Send dit CV eller en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring til Rekruttering Djursland via kontaktoplysningerne i annoncen.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os for en uforpligtende samtale.

Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

jobs.title: Coordinateur Maintenance Site (H/F)
jobs.description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader of paper-based packaging solutions. With more than 100,000 employees, 500 converting operations, and 59 mills across 40 countries, we provide our customers with an expansive range of distinctive, innovative products. Learn more about how we're creating the future of packaging together.

Le poste :

SMURFIT WESTROCK Distribution Vin (SWDV) déploie sa compétence packaging auprès du marché de la viticulture au bénéfice des plus belles appellations de Gironde - Saint Emilion, Pessac, Médoc et pour ses autres clients en France.
Avec 30 collaborateurs spécialistes engagés, cette filiale du groupe international SMURFIT WESTROCK, déploie un processus complet de transformation du carton et de Supply Chain pour proposer des produits sur-mesure toujours plus innovants pour leurs clients, et meilleurs pour la planète (#BetterPlanetPackaging).
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, VECTEUR HUMAIN, Cabinet régional indépendant expert en Approche directe & RH, recrute pour son partenaire SWDV basé à Beychac-et-Caillau (33), son futur(e) : Coordinateur Maintenance Site F/H.
Au sein du site SMURFIT WESTROCK Distribution Vin, vous êtes en charge de garantir le bon fonctionnement et l'amélioration de l'outil de production et des services généraux.
Rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement au Directeur de site, vous mettez en oeuvre les actions de maintenance nécessaires à la réalisation des objectifs de performance du site en déployant la stratégie de l'entreprise dans le respect des valeurs du Groupe et de ses spécificités régionales.
Dans cette structure industrielle moderne, exigeante, visant l'excellence industrielle avec un environnement de santé et sécurité optimal, voici un aperçu « non exhaustif » de vos activités :
En support de l'atelier de production - impression, façonnage et montage, vous :

- Assurez la maintenance et le dépannage courant des organes mécaniques, pneumatiques, hydrauliques, électriques et automatismes ; Recherches de pannes, remplacements d'éléments, remises en état, mécanique industrielle.
- Réalisez les maintenances planifiées et effectuez des contrôles réglementaires ;
- Améliorez la performance des équipements de production et notamment la performance énergétique ;
- Proposez des améliorations du matériel - fiabilité, productivité ;
- Échangez avec les conducteurs pour restituer votre intervention et recommandez les bonnes pratiques d'utilisation et maintenance de 1er niveau ;
- Gérez la documentation technique et les pièces détachées, approvisionnez les stocks de consommables ;
- Ponctuellement auprès de nos clients locaux, vous intervenez sur des machines similaires aux nôtres mises à leur disposition.

Pour l'ensemble du site, vous :

- Pilotez des prestataires de tous corps de métiers : fournisseurs de machines, intervenant en maintenance ou travaux neuf, entretien du parc chariot élévateurs, sécurité incendie et bâtiment ;
- Suivez le budget et la facturation des intervenants, pièces, consommables ;
- Assurez le suivi des contrôles périodiques réglementaires (chariots élévateurs, racks') en lien avec le préventeur santé sécurité et le directeur de site ;
- Participerez à l'implantation de nouvelles machines et installations ou à leur évolution (ajouts de fonctionnalités, évolutions réglementaires) ;
- Êtes le garant de la sécurité de vos chantiers et des interventions externes dans le respect des protocoles de consignation et de sécurisation du Groupe - plans de prévention, permis feu, travail en hauteur?



Profil recherché :

De formation technique de niveau Bac à Bac+2 en Maintenance industrielle, Électrotechnique ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience professionnelle significative en maintenance industrielle.
Une expérience des services généraux constituerait un véritable atout.
Vous avez évolué à des fonctions de Coordinateur de maintenance, Gestionnaire de maintenance, Technicien de maintenance ou Électromécanicien expérimenté, vous ayant permis de développer une solide vision opérationnelle des activités de maintenance et de fiabilisation des équipements industriels.
Vous disposez de solides compétences techniques en mécanique, électromécanique, hydraulique et pneumatique, ainsi que d'une bonne maîtrise des méthodes et processus de maintenance. À l'aise avec les outils informatiques, vous utilisez quotidiennement une GMAO et savez assurer le suivi des interventions, piloter des entreprises sous-traitantes et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la performance des installations.
Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité d'analyse, vous savez diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements, identifier les solutions les plus adaptées et être force de proposition dans une logique de fiabilisation des équipements.
Votre autonomie et votre sens du service vous permettent d'intervenir efficacement auprès des équipes de production tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de sécurité, de qualité...

jobs.title: CTS-Projektteknikker
jobs.description:
CTS-Projektteknikker med ambitioner om mere? Bliv en del af ALTEQ

Er du stærk på CTS, programmering og Niagara – og har du samtidig lyst til at udvikle dig mod projektledelse, kunderådgivning og forretningsudvikling?

Hos ALTEQ søger vi en CTS-projekttekniker, der trives med selvstændige opgaver og tekniske udfordringer, men som også har ambitioner om at spille en større rolle i fremtidens CTS-forretning. Derfor er denne stilling oplagt for dig, der på sigt ønsker at udvikle dig mod projektledelse, salg og udvikling af nye kunder og markeder.

En spændende rolle med udviklingsmuligheder

Du bliver en del af en specialiseret CTS-virksomhed med høj faglighed og korte beslutningsveje. I starten vil dit fokus primært være på de tekniske opgaver, men vi ser gerne, at du har interessen og lysten til gradvist at tage større ansvar inden for både kundeudvikling og forretningsudvikling.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den færdige projektleder – vi søger den rette person med potentialet til at blive det.

Dine opgaver som projektteknikker:

Som projekttekniker hos ALTEQ får du en alsidig hverdag med fokus på CTS, programmering og teknisk rådgivning. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Programmering og idriftsættelse af CTS-anlæg

  • Udvikling og optimering af tekniske løsninger

  • Arbejde med Tridium Niagara-platformen

  • Fejlfinding og teknisk sparring med kunder og kollegaer

  • Deltagelse i projektering og projektgennemførelse

  • Kundemøder og teknisk rådgivning

  • På sigt deltagelse i salgsmøder og udvikling af nye kunderelationer

Det får du hos ALTEQ 

Hos ALTEQ får du stor frihed til at planlægge din egen hverdag. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde, men vi værdsætter også det faglige og sociale fællesskab på kontoret, hvor vi sparrer med hinanden og udvikler os sammen.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og pensionsordning, og gode ansættelsesvilkår

  • Stor indflydelse på egen rolle og udvikling

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling – herunder på sigt projektledelse og forretningsudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads præget af høj faglighed, ordentlighed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Stor indflydelse på egen rolle i en virksomhed i vækst

Om dig som vores nye kollega:

Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund og erfaring med CTS-løsninger. Du trives med ansvar, arbejder struktureret og har lyst til løbende at udvikle dig. Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har solid programmeringserfaring

  • Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund fx som elektriker eller el-installatør og har solid erfaring med CTS og el-tekniske løsninger.

  • Har indgående kendskab til Tridium Niagara (krav)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har en struktureret tilgang og følger opgaver til dørs

  • Trives i dialogen med både kunder og kollegaer

  • Har interesse for eller lyst til at udvikle dig inden for salg, kunderelationer og forretningsudvikling

Om ALTEQ

ALTEQ er en specialiseret installations- og CTS-virksomhed i udvikling med base i Roskilde. Her er der korte beslutningsveje, tæt samarbejde og en ledelse, der er nærværende i hverdagen. Virksomheden er kendetegnet ved høj faglighed, stærke kunderelationer og en kultur, hvor ambitioner og menneskeligt overskud går hånd i hånd.

Om FLD
FLD er medejer af ALTEQ og består samlet set af ca. 270 medarbejdere med stærke kompetencer indenfor el, VVS, CTS, energi, teknik og service. For dig betyder det, at du bliver en del af en større organisation i ryggen med stærke kompetencer til rådighed på tværs af de to virksomheder.

Er du vores nye projektteknikker hos ALTEQ?

Hvis du kan se dig selv som vores nye projektteknikker hos ALTEQ i Roskilde, så tøv ikke med at kontakte os. Send din ansøgning og CV til direktør hos ALTEQ, Dennis Holmeskov Hansen på mail: dhh@alteq.dk. Ansættelse hurtigst muligt, men vi venter også gerne på den helt rette.

Læs også

VVS-servicemontør med blikerfaring søges til opgaver på Midtsjælland

Vægter du en god arbejdsplads, hvor der er fokus på trivsel og tryghed i hverdagen? Så bliv VVS-servicemontør hos FLD i Haslev. For den rette profil vil der være tale om en forventet mangeårig ansættelse med egne faste kunder i lokalområdet. Du skal have erfaring med blikarbejde.

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor nærvær, relationer og udvikling er vigtigere end hurtige løsninger?

Hos Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard søger vi en engageret pædagog, som har lyst til at gøre en reel forskel for børn og unge, der har brug for stabile voksne, tydelige rammer og et hjem, hvor de kan udvikle sig.

Hos os er et job ikke bare et arbejde – det er en mulighed for at blive en betydningsfuld voksen i et barns liv.

Hvem er vi?

Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard er et socialpædagogisk døgntilbud for børn og unge med blandt andet omsorgssvigt, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, ADHD, udviklingsvanskeligheder og sociale eller følelsesmæssige udfordringer.

Vi arbejder ud fra en relationel, anerkendende og mentaliserende tilgang, hvor vi tror på, at:

  • Alle børn har udviklingspotentiale.

  • Tætte relationer skaber de største forandringer.

  • Diagnoser aldrig må definere barnets muligheder.

  • Udvikling skabes gennem engagement, struktur, omsorg og høj faglighed.

Vores pædagogiske fundament bygger blandt andet på:

  • AMA – Anerkend, Mentaliser, Ager

  • Growth Mindset

  • SMART-mål og systematisk dokumentation

  • En helhedsorienteret forståelse af det enkelte barn

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor du blandt andet skal:

  • skabe trygge og udviklende relationer til børn og unge

  • understøtte struktur og trivsel i hverdagen

  • planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter

  • samarbejde med familier, skoler, kommuner og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • dokumentere udvikling og deltage aktivt i statusarbejde og evaluering

  • indgå i døgnets forskellige vagter, herunder aften- og weekendvagter.

Vi søger dig, som

  • er uddannet pædagog

  • trives med ansvar og kan bevare roen i komplekse situationer

  • arbejder anerkendende, nysgerrigt og mentaliserende

  • kan skabe tydelige rammer med varme og nærvær

  • er fagligt ambitiøs og ønsker løbende udvikling

  • ser samarbejde som en styrke og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

  • har kørekort (kategori B).

Erfaring fra socialområdet er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lysten, engagementet og de personlige kompetencer til at gøre en forskel.

Hos os får du

  • en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold

  • grundig introduktion og mentorforløb

  • løbende supervision og sparring

  • gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og kompetenceudvikling

  • stor indflydelse på den pædagogiske praksis

  • engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden

  • en arbejdsplads med humor, nærvær og høje ambitioner på børnenes vegne.

Vi tror på relationer

Børnene bor ofte hos os gennem en stor del af deres barndom. Derfor tror vi på, at de voksne omkring dem skal være autentiske, engagerede og stabile. Vi ser os selv som en del af hinandens livshistorier, og vi gør os umage – hver eneste dag.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i den tilgang, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er på fuld tid og ønskes besat hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Karen Brostrøm på 53436322

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til info@bollerskov.dk.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Unicon søger pumpechauffør til Sjælland
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med store maskiner, tage ansvar på komplekse byggeprojekter og være den, der får betonen sikkert frem til målet?

Hos Unicon søger vi en pumpechauffør til vores team i Avedøre. Har du den rette erfaring, tekniske forståelse og motivation, hjælper vi dig eventuelt med det nødvendige kørekort og de relevante certifikater. I videoen nederst kan du se eksempler på det udstyr, du skal køre og betjene.

Du kan naturligvis være Pumpechauffør i dag, men du kan lige så godt være uddannet maskinfører eller have tilsvarende erfaring. Du kan også være i entreprenørbranchen, betonbranchen eller landbruget. Det vigtigste er, at du trives med store maskiner, kan tage ansvar og bevare overblikket, når opgaverne bliver komplekse.

Du får ansvar for en af byggepladsens vigtigste opgaver

Som pumpechauffør hos Unicon er du specialist på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger, betonchauffører, byggeledere og kunder for at sikre, at støbningen bliver gennemført sikkert, effektivt og i den rigtige kvalitet.

Du er med til at sikre, at betonen bliver leveret og pumpet i den rette hastighed, så støbningen forløber som planlagt, og kunden får det resultat, der er aftalt. Det kræver både teknisk forståelse, gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at træffe beslutninger, når forholdene ændrer sig.

Som pumpechauffør kører du pumpebilen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen. Her placerer du udstyret sikkert – ofte under trange forhold – og opsætter pumpen, så den passer til den konkrete opgave. Når støbningen går i gang, betjener du det avancerede pumpeudstyr og fungerer som kundens sparringspartner på pladsen.

Unicon er markedsleder i Danmark, og du bliver en del af projekter, der sætter varige spor i samfundet – fra boligbyggeri og infrastruktur til større erhvervs- og anlægsprojekter.

Hvem er du?

Din vej til jobbet kan være forskellig, men vi forestiller os, at du opfylder mindst ét af disse kriterier:

  • Uddannet maskinfører eller tilsvarende erfaring

  • Erfaring med beton- og støbearbejde

  • Erfaring med større maskiner og processer fra f.eks. landbrug eller industri

  • Erfaring med kraner, entreprenørmateriel eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Relevant erfaring fra entreprenør- eller byggebranchen

Lige så vigtigt er det, at du:

  • Trives med ansvar og selvstændige beslutninger

  • Har en god teknisk og mekanisk forståelse

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og serviceminded

  • Kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt

  • Arbejder sikkert, struktureret og løsningsorienteret

Stort kørekort og EU-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du den rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring samt mulighed for at opnå relevante kørekort og certifikater.

Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne udstyr og spændende arbejdsopgaver

  • Mulighed for at få relevante kørekort og certifikater gennem Unicon

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en unik holdånd

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

En arbejdsform med frihed, ansvar og gode muligheder for afspadsering

Som pumpechauffør arbejder du ikke efter et traditionelt 7-15-skema.

Når en større støbning er i gang, bliver vi på pladsen, til opgaven er løst. Derfor vil du opleve perioder med lange arbejdsdage og en del overarbejde. Til gengæld får du både den løn, der følger med, og gode muligheder for at opspare afspadsering – ofte i form af hele fridage.

Mange af vores pumpechauffører sætter pris på friheden og variationen i jobbet. Nogle dage er kortere, andre længere, men fælles for dem alle er, at man arbejder sammen om at få opgaven sikkert i mål.

Hvis du trives med ansvar, variation og tanken om at gøre arbejdet færdigt frem for at kigge på klokken, vil du passe godt ind hos os.

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig – også selvom du ikke opfylder alle kravene på papiret.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ib Jepsen på telefon 2484 0935.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon

Hos Unicon tror vi på, at forskellighed skaber stærkere teams. Vi arbejder aktivt for et inkluderende arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle medarbejdere behandles med respekt, værdighed og lige muligheder.

Ansættelser sker på baggrund af kvalifikationer, kompetencer og potentiale, og vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge uanset baggrund.

jobs.title: Technical Storekeeper
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Storekeeper is responsible for handling and managing the receiving, storage, and processing of incoming and outgoing spare parts and technical supplies at one or more Carnival Corporation owned and operated global destination. This role supports the overall management of inventory levels, ensuring that all materials are accurately accounted for, properly stored, and readily available for technical teams as needed. The Technical Storekeeper monitors stock levels, maintains accurate records, coordinates with procurement for replenishment, and ensures compliance with company policies and safety standards. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with maintenance and technical staff to support smooth operational workflows.

  • Inventory Management and Record Keeping
  • Keep accurate records regarding stock counts, requirements, and reporting needs.
  • Review and issue a weekly inventory list of technical spares.
  • Update and maintain system records upon arrival of new parts and tools.
  • Label and maintain all tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Audit incoming materials for accurate paperwork and counts.
  • Confirm deliveries against invoices for accuracy of store count.
  • Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock situations.
  • Track usage of spare parts to support maintenance planning and budgeting.
  • Ordering and Procurement Support
  • Place requests for all parts necessary for the storeroom for review and approval.
  • Assist with purchasing items and materials as needed.
  • Liaise with staff, management, and vendors to source supplies efficiently.
  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of parts.
  • Review vendor quotes and maintain records of supplier transactions.
  • Suggest alternatives for unavailable or discontinued parts.
  • Stores Organization and Receiving
  • Maintain stores in an organized and well-ordered manner.
  • Assist with unloading containers, sorting, counting, and receiving materials.
  • Ensure proper storage, handling, and labeling of all parts and tools.
  • Implement storage systems to maximize space and accessibility.
  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure cleanliness and orderliness of storerooms.
  • Follow safety protocols when handling heavy or hazardous materials.
  • Reporting, Compliance, and Other Duties
  • Create required reports related to inventory, usage, and discrepancies.
  • Uphold environmental policies and procedures in all store operations.
  • Document and report any damaged or defective parts to management.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by management.
  • Support cross-functional teams by providing required spare parts and technical materials.
  • Assist in audits and inspections as needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Needed

  • Ability to adhere to the companyâs standards regarding dress and appearance.

  • Ability to work in an outdoor environment as needed.
  • May need to stand for long periods of time.

  • Knowledge: Understanding of workplace policies and procedures / Familiarity with team collaboration tools and techniques.
  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks.

HESS Responsibilities

jobs.title: CHEFE DE COZINHA
jobs.description:
Pretende se recrutar um a Chef de Cozinha para integrar um novo projeto de restauração privilegiando candidatos com forte motivação sentido de responsabilidade e vontade de crescer profissionalmente.

Será responsável pela preparação confeção e empratamento dos produtos garantindo elevados padrões de qualidade apresentação e consistência. Deverá colaborar na organização da cozinha gestão de stocks receção e armazenamento de mercadorias controlo de desperdícios e cumprimento rigoroso das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar HACCP.

Procura se um profissional organizado dinâmico com capacidade para trabalhar em equipa gerir o tempo de forma eficiente e manter um bom desempenho em períodos de maior exigência. Valoriza se uma atitude proativa atenção ao detalhe capacidade de aprendizagem e compromisso com a melhoria contínua.

É valorizada formação na área da cozinha e restauração e ou experiência profissional em funções semelhantes. No entanto serão igualmente considerados candidatos com potencial de desenvolvimento desde que demonstrem interesse pela profissão vontade de aprender e capacidade de integração numa equipa orientada para a qualidade e excelência no serviço.

O profissional terá a oportunidade de participar no desenvolvimento e crescimento de um novo conceito de restauração beneficiando de acompanhamento contínuo formação em contexto de trabalho e possibilidade de integração futura na empresa de acordo com o desempenho demonstrado.

Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.



This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

during beta, yes â both tiers, no credit card, no trial clock. after beta: core is $10/machine/month for monitoring, control, deploy, displays, and cortex on a single site. pro is $50/machine/month (3-machine minimum) and adds the public API, CLI, SDK, webhooks, unlimited sites, and roost â incremental project sync with 1 TB included storage per site. no per-user fees on either.

the agent keeps running. it monitors and auto-recovers processes whether or not it can reach the cloud. when the connection returns, it syncs everything it missed. your machines don't need the internet to run. they've been alone before. they know how to survive.

no inbound ports, no vpn. agents connect outbound over https (port 443) to google's firebase infrastructure. if your network allows general internet access, it just works. locked-down environments may need to whitelist *.googleapis.com and *.firebaseio.com.

cortex is owlette's ai fleet assistant â ask it the questions you ask yourself every day: "which nvidia driver are we running?", "restart the media server on node 3", "what crashed at 3am?" it translates natural language into real commands across your fleet. you bring your own api key (openai, anthropic, or any compatible provider).

roost is owlette's project sync. point it at a folder â a TouchDesigner project, a content drop, a build output â and it ships only the bytes that changed to every machine on the site, atomically: a machine gets the whole new version or stays on the old one, never a half-copied mess. every deploy is versioned, so you can roll back to any of the last 50 for up to 30 days. it's part of the pro tier and includes 1 TB of storage per site ($0.05/GB after that). no more zipping a folder and RDP-ing into ten machines at 2am.

agents connect over tls, credentials are encrypted on-device using a machine-bound key, and oauth tokens are never logged or stored in plaintext. access is managed through firebase auth with optional passkey and two-factor authentication.

yes â owlette is FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (converts to apache 2.0 two years after each release). the full source is on github. fair warning: it requires firebase, a railway (or equivalent) deployment for the web app, and a willingness to blow past your usage limits at 3am debugging support tickets from your neighbor's camper because your furnace broke and it's -10 outside. we won't talk you out of it, but the hosted version exists for a reason.

jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

jobs.title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - High Voltage; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you searching for a place to work where you can truly make a difference and have a leading role in our continued expansion? A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Head of Solution Engineering, PLM – Jesper S. Rytke +45 2721 9705.
